page: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v5 is a memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor. Governed by the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, the virtual machine provides 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at clock speeds reaching 3.7 GHz. The system includes 672.0 GB of RAM, yielding 7.0 GB of memory per vCPU, along with 3865 GB of integrated local SSD storage. No discrete graphics processing units are present on this server configuration.

Benchmark evaluations show strong multi-threaded execution, with multi-core stress-ng achieving 129,546.26 and PassMark CPU encryption reaching 102,892.71, both placing in the top 10% of tested systems. Hardware cryptographic acceleration is sustained by dedicated AES, VAES, and SHA-NI instruction sets. The memory subsystem recorded a top-tier PassMark memory score of 3,059.57 and delivered 92.17 million Redis SET operations per second. In contrast, single-thread performance benchmarks, such as a 1,730.0 Geekbench single-core score and uncached write bandwidth of 63.74 GB/sec, align within middle percentiles.

The integration of 3865 GB of local SSD capacity provides high local I/O capacity without requiring auxiliary non-volatile storage attachments for temporary data. Although the architecture lacks AVX-512 vector extensions, its high memory ceiling, top-tier cryptographic throughput, and strong database metrics make it suited for large-scale in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, high-volume transactional systems, and distributed ETL batch processes.
description: Microsoft Azure E96ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 96 vCPUs derived from 48 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7763 processor operating at up to 3.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture under Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance pairs 672.0 GB of system memory with 3865 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage, omitting dedicated GPUs. Benchmark results highlight top-decile multi-core processing in stress-ng (129,546.26), top-tier cryptographic throughput via dedicated hardware flags (102,892.71), and a top-10% PassMark memory rating of 3,059.57. Memory operations achieve 92.17 million Redis SET operations per second, supported by multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 470.76 GB/sec. While single-thread benchmarks and uncached write throughput sit in middle tiers, the consolidated high-capacity RAM and integrated fast local disk deliver efficient resource utilization for in-memory databases, large-scale caching engines, data warehousing, and demanding relational database workloads.
